sources.source: Statistics Sweden (SCB), average monthly salary after sector, all sectors, total gender.
sources.unit: SEK/month; annual comparator calculated as monthly × 12
sources.definition: SCB average monthly salary across all sectors, both sexes (total gender), for each year 1992–2025. Salary is not disposable income or actual annual earnings.
sources.transformation: Annual comparator is monthly average multiplied by 12; nominal values. Monthly source values retained in the separate salary file.

sources.source: FZ.se's 2017 summary of Swedish new console prices, based on Cuponation's compilation from historical Swedish articles and forums including FZ, Aftonbladet and Sweclockers.
sources.unit: nominal SEK per console at Swedish launch
sources.definition: Reported Swedish new retail price at launch for the original Nintendo console model; these are discrete product launch observations, not calendar-year average retail prices.
sources.coverage: Sweden; eight observations: NES 1987, SNES 1992, Nintendo 64 1997, GameCube 2002, Wii 2006, Wii U Basic and Premium 2012, and Switch 2017. The NES year is FZ/Cuponation's report; Swedish retail availability is documented from 1 September 1986, so the source's 1987 launch year is inconsistent and not treated as a verified 1986 price. Wii U is split into two launch packages because the contemporary Swedish source reports distinct Basic and Premium prices. Wii is marked approximate; FZ reported about 2,700 SEK including VAT and one game on release day. FZ/Cuponation's entries are a secondary compilation; see per-row source_url and price_basis in the data file.
sources.transformation: Nominal Swedish launch-price observations transcribed as published. The Wii price is approximate, not an exact list price; Wii U Basic/Premium are separate packages. Wage share is reported price divided by SCB average monthly salary for the same year × 12 × 100 when a matching salary exists. No inflation adjustment, no annualization, and no trend arrow between different hardware models.

data.price_basis: FZ/Cuponation reports 1987; Swedish retail launch is separately documented in 1986
